unresolved_gaps: OGE pages list many unyearized December and January deadlines. Do not assign them to Fall 2027 until an explicit cycle source confirms the year.
The draft's Linguistics SM, Mathematics of Data SM, and Computational Science and Engineering SM are cataloged awards, but OGE pages do not establish open master's admission routes.
EECS SM is not a terminal master's admission route; MEng options for Courses 6-P, 6-7P, and 6-14P serve qualified MIT undergraduates through an internal process.
Sloan Fellows MBA OGE page lists only MBA while the MIT Sloan curriculum lists alternative SM awards; their admission target may be shared, but award selection timing needs review.
Tuition, mandatory fees, funding, and applicant-specific test requirements have not been migrated for these new candidates.
The Biomedical Engineering MEng and fifth-year Mathematics MASc are restricted to current MIT students; their internal application destinations are not yet verified.
The fragment intentionally omits unyearized OGE deadlines from runtime_routes. Review the relevant program page for the selected entry cycle before displaying a date.

Civil Engineer, Environmental Engineer, Materials Engineer, and Engineer in Aeronautics and Astronautics are officially awarded, but this review did not establish a separate application target for each.
